versions.changelog:
- Initial release of gif-sticker-maker skill.
- Converts user photos into 4 animated GIF stickers in Funko Pop / Pop Mart style, each with a caption.
- Supports custom or language-aware default captions for stickers.
- Automated workflow: photo analysis, image generation, animation, and GIF conversion.
- Outputs a strict `<deliver_assets>` block with all 4 GIF stickers in order.
